channel.location: After prepared 3-qubit token state, before measurement; separate repetition encoder/recovery per logical feature qubit
channel.noise: Independent physical X errors with probability p during one memory interval; ideal encoding, syndrome, correction and decoding
channel.identity: Each Pauli-Z product of weight w attenuates by (1-2p_eff)^w, p_eff=f^levels(p), f(p)=3p²-2p³
channel.assumptions: Recovered tensor-product logical X channel follows from single-block Bell-reference channel and disjoint independent error blocks, valid for entangled logical input
channel.executed: Original3-qubit feature states, exact8-logical-error density mixtures and complete saved classical prediction heads; no9/27-qubit gate/noisy recovery simulation
channel.limitation: Ideal memory layer only; no phase-error protection, noisy gates, noisy syndrome, correlated noise, threshold or fault-tolerance claim
